headline: Deemed dogs at 42 Cornell St and 40 Adams St dangerous; fined owner of Emery at 1859 Roosevelt Ave $500.
summary: The meeting covered dog hearings for five dogs and approval of earlier minutes. Dogs Orion and Ace, and White Boy/Prince, were deemed dangerous, and the dog Emery was deemed a nuisance and its owner was fined $500. A complaint about Callie and Bella was withdrawn at the complainant's request.
decisions: Approved the October 16, 2025 minutes, 4 yes votes, 1 absent.
Passed a "No Findings" motion for the dangerous dog hearing for Phoebe, owned by Mary Luz Ramos at 58 Fremont St, 4 yes votes, 1 absent.
Complaint in the nuisance dog hearing for Callie and Bella at 58 Cherrelyn St was withdrawn after the complainant asked to drop it.
Deemed the dogs Orion and Ace, owned by Shavon Diaz at 42 Cornell St, dangerous dogs, 4 yes votes, 1 absent.
Imposed eight conditions on Orion and Ace, including restraint, confinement, sterilization, a secure enclosure, and proof of insurance, 4 yes votes, 1 absent.
Deemed the dog White Boy/Prince, owned by Edwin Gonzales at 40 Adams St, a dangerous dog, with conditions, 4 yes votes, 1 absent.
Deemed the dog Emery, owned by Amanda-Lee Camacho at 1859 Roosevelt Ave, a nuisance dog, 4 yes votes, 1 absent.
Fined Amanda-Lee Camacho $500 for failing to comply with the orders dated October 16, 2025 and July 31, 2025, 4 yes votes, 1 absent.

Animal Control Hearing  
                                                              Minutes 
Call to Order 
10:00 AM Meeting called to order on Thursday, December 18, 2025 at City Hall -- Room 
205, 36 Court Street, Springfield, MA. 
 
Attendee Name Title Status Arrived 
Melvin A. Edwards Ward 3 Councilor Present  
Keith Fleming Police  Present  
Camile Nelson Campbell Assistant City Clerk Present  
Megan Landry Board Member Present  
Veronica Johns Board Member Absent  
Approval of Minutes 
1. October 16, 2025 Minutes 
Read. 
Board Member Landry made a motion to accept the minutes the motion was 
seconded by Board Member Edwards. 
 
Roll call votes on the motion 
 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns     Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell yes 
 
Motion passed by roll call votes. 
 
Minutes approved. 
Dog Hearing 
2. A Dangerous Dog Hearing for a dog named Phoebe Owned by Mary Luz Ramos at 
58 Fremont St. 
 
Read.
Renee Robichaud, Animal Control Officer for Thomas J. O’Connor (TJO) and Adoption Center 
read their reports.   
 
Complainant  
 
Respondent 
 
Rebuttal 
None 
Board Member Edwards made a motion No Findings the motion was seconded by 
Board Member Fleming. 
 
Roll call votes on the motion 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell Yes 
 
 
Motion passed by roll call votes. 
 
3. A Nuisance Dog Hearing for a Dog named Callie and Bella at 58 Cherrelyn St 
Owned by Tyran Daniels who lives at 59 Stebbins Street. 
Maria Ramos called Wednesday, December 17th, 2025 and asked to drop the complaint. 
 
4. A Dangerous Dog Hearing for Two Dogs Named Orion and Ace Owned by Shavon 
Diaz at 42 Cornell St 
Read. 
 
Renee Robichaud, Animal Control Officer for Thomas J. O’Connor (TJO) and Adoption Center 
read their reports.   
 
Complainant
Mshae Hudson, the owner of Willow. She stated the night before the incident she saw the 
two (2) huskie’s dogs on St James Avenue. The next morning, she received a phone call 
stating Willow has been found. 
Mary Taylor said she Agrees with Mshae Testimony.  
Respondent 
Shavone Diaz did not appear. 
Rebuttal 
None 
Board Member Edwards made a motion to deem the dogs named Orion and Ace 
dangerous dogs the motion was seconded by Board Member Fleming. 
 
Roll call votes on the motion 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell Yes 
 
Motion passed by roll call votes. 
 
After review of the hearing testimonies and the Thomas J. O’Connor Animal 
Control and Adoption Center reports, the Committee has imposed the following 
conditions on Orion and Ace: 
 
1. That both dogs be humanely restrained, in accordance with c. 110 § 10 of the Code; 
 
2. That the dogs be confined to the premises of the owner of the dogs; provided, however, that 
"confined" shall mean securely confined indoors or confined outdoors in a securely enclosed and 
locked pen or dog run area upon the premises of the owner; provided however, that such 
confinement shall comply with c. 110 § 8 of the code, in accordance with c. 110 § 10 of the 
Code; 
 
3. That whenever the dogs are removed from the premises of the owner, the dogs shall be 
securely and humanely muzzled and restrained with a leash having a minimum tensile strength of 
300 pounds and not exceeding three feet in length, in accordance with c. 110 § 10 of the Code;
4. That the dogs shall be surgically sterilized, microchipped, and registered to the City, with all 
costs associated with these services to be borne by the owner, in accordance with c. 110 § 10 of 
the Code the Code; 
 
5.  That the owner construct, within two weeks from the date of decision, a secure enclosure (as 
defined in c. 110 § 1 of the Code) to house the dogs when they are in the owner's yard in 
accordance with c. 110 § 10 of the Code. The Advisory and Hearing Committee may order that, 
during the construction period, the dogs be publicly impounded at an animal shelter or a private 
veterinary hospital until the secure enclosure is constructed. The effectiveness of the secure 
enclosure shall be subject to approval and periodic inspections by an Animal Control Officer, as 
deemed necessary. The fee for said inspection shall be $75. If the owner is found in violation of 
the secure enclosure requirements, immediate public impoundment of the dogs shall be done by 
the animal control center during the time the violation continues to exist, and the owner shall 
bear all costs for such public impoundment. The fine for such violation shall be $200 per animal,  
as described in c. 110 § 4 of the Code; 
 
6.  That ownership of the dogs may not be transferred unless the transfer of ownership is to an 
adult residing within the same residence, and said dogs shall remain housed solely at that 
residence, in accordance with c. 110 § 10 of the Code; 
 
7.  That, where the owner of the dogs fails to appear at the hearing in front of the Advisory and 
Hearing Committee, and the dogs are declared dangerous dogs, the dogs shall be impounded in 
accordance with c. 110 § 10 of the Code, until all conditions outlined in this decision have been 
met; and 
 
 
8. That the owner or keeper of the dogs provide proof of insurance in an amount not less than 
$100,000 insuring the owner or keeper against any claim, loss, damage or injury to persons, 
domestic animals or property resulting from the acts, whether intentional or unintentional, of the 
dogs or proof that reasonable efforts were made to obtain such insurance if a policy has not been 
issued; provided, however, that if a policy of insurance has been issued, the owner or keeper 
shall produce such policy upon request of the hearing authority or a justice of the district court; 
and provided further, that if a policy has not been issued the owner or keeper shall produce proof 
of efforts to obtain such insurance, in accordance with Massachusetts General Law (M.G.L.) c. 
140 § 157(c)(iv) and c. 110 § 10 of the Code; and 
 
Roll call votes on the Conditions 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell Yes

multiple times because she’s sick of this, it’s obnoxious and she don’t think it’s appropriate 
for his dog to roam without any responsibility.

Edwin Gonzalez did not appear

None

Roll call votes on the motion 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell Yes
Motion passed by roll call votes. 
 
 
Non-Compliance  
6. A Non-Compliance Nuisance Dog Hearing for a dog named Emery owned by 
Amanda-Lee Camacho at 1859 Roosevelt Ave 
 
Read. 
Renee Robichaud, Animal Control Officer for Thomas J. O’Connor (TJO) and Adoption Center 
read their reports.   
 
Complainant 
Thomas J. O’Connor. 
Respondent 
None 
Rebuttal 
None 
Board Member Edwards made a motion to deem the dog named Emery a nuisance 
dog the motion was seconded by Board Member Fleming. 
 
Roll call votes on the motion 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell Yes 
 
 
Motion passed by roll call votes. 
 
After review of the hearing testimonies and the Thomas J. O’Connor Animal Control and 
Adoption Center reports, the Committee has imposed the following conditions on Emery: 
 
On December 18, 2025, a non-compliance dog hearing was held by the Animal Control and Hearing 
Committee, in accordance with c. 110 § 10 of the Code of the City of Springfield (hereinafter called the 
‘Code”), as amended October 17, 2016, regarding your dog, Emery.
At the Non-Compliance Hearing, the Committee found the orders dated October 16, 2025 and July 
31,2025, attached hereto, were valid and that you failed to comply with said orders. Therefore, the 
Committee has voted to fine you Five Hundred Dollars (500.00) pursuant to Chapter 140 Section 157A of 
the Massachusetts General Laws (M.G.L). 
Please note that transferring ownership or possession of your dog is prohibited under M.G.L.c. 140 § 
157A(c).  The order issued on July 31, 2025, is still valid, and the bill issued on October 23, 2025 in the 
amount of five hundred dollars ($500.00) is still outstanding. 
 
Roll call votes on the conditions 
Board member Edwards  Yes  
Board member Fleming  Yes 
Board member Johns   Absent 
Board member Landry  Yes 
Board member Nelson Campbell yes 
 
Condition passed by roll call votes
